author: Hero Hei
description:
On January 18th during the Deadpool Creator Cup tournament, player Kingsman265 was unfortunately teamed up with a number of entitled streamers who played terribly and then insulted him when he made very reasonable suggestions. The women he was paired with then got him kicked from the entire tournament. However, when the internet found out about what happened, those female streamers faced a wave of justified criticism. They then attempted to play victim but that didn't go well for them, as no one fell for their lies. Fortunately, Kingsman265 did get a very wholesome ending to the entire ordeal.
